visuals.heading: Pay Range for Starting a Business Vs Job

figures.label: Pay Range
figures.source: On top of personal expenses, plan separate business capital covering roughly 12-18 months of your estimated monthly burn rate, rent, tools, any salaries, inventory, marketing. About 65% of Indian startups begin with less than ₹10 lakh in capital, which means bootstrapping tight, not chasing outside funding, is the realistic path for most first-time founders, not the exception.
